notes.title: New Playtest Map: Seafood Market
notes.content:
[h1]New Map: Seafood Market[/h1]
Who doesn't love miscellaneous seafood? Possibly fished from a marsh? Mmm Tasty...
This is one of the intermediate locations that is not required and not even on a path to other required stops so it's totally optional. The main reward for visiting this location is seeing unique content.

[h2]Adding Music?[/h2]
That's right, I'm working on a music system in ShantyTown that adjusts based on how you're playing. Right now the only location with an available musical track is the [b]Lighthouse[/b] map, please check it out and let me know what you think!

As usual I'll also be adding a few more people to the playtest so if you get the email, welcome!
Please try it out and let me know what you think!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44370077/8c028ae431e70bb939177f76d00a849d74ea949d.png[/img]

If you want to learn more about the playtest, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2434600/view/525335573256210705]check out the event[/url].

Please share [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeYyq4kSHRUZhrxbWAMerGgtHCGD4Smk215KVInwiu1j_A_zg/viewform?usp=dialog]general feedback here[/url] and more [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScLXttIBtg5PRn-MZaB8Z6vA66MvQ1CvLQV_syVsWhZF8dZCA/viewform?usp=dialog]map specific feedback here[/url] and [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeVPwozadcjOLr3O3GduxenFFSvYMLZ-v9zJkJfI6I2Ov4Dfw/viewform?usp=dialog]bug reports here[/url].

[h2]Changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Updated all pages of the dossier
[*] Added music at the Lighthouse
[*] Esc now cancels placement
[*] Testing a new “rewards” system when upgrading buildings
[*] Added new "unique" items
[/list]

[h2]Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Hopefully fixed some placement issues at Shanty Town
[/list]

Thanks for joining the playtest of [b]ShantyTown[/b]!
-Erik

notes.title: New Playtest Map: Shanty Town
notes.content:
[h1]New Map: Shanty Town[/h1]
Yes, that's right, the map has the same name as the game!
But this was the map that inspired the game itself, before the entire world was built. You can see a bit more of what the game looked like before the world was added [url=https://youtu.be/lcYWG2QiA1o]in this devlog[/url].

I'll also be adding a few more people to the playtest so if you get the email, welcome!
Please try it out and let me know what you think!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44370077/877b23fd3bae928ab7bc584ae7245cbe00e82b85.png[/img]

If you want to learn more about the playtest, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2434600/view/525335573256210705]check out the event[/url].

Please share [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeYyq4kSHRUZhrxbWAMerGgtHCGD4Smk215KVInwiu1j_A_zg/viewform?usp=dialog]general feedback here[/url] and more [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScLXttIBtg5PRn-MZaB8Z6vA66MvQ1CvLQV_syVsWhZF8dZCA/viewform?usp=dialog]map specific feedback here[/url] and [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeVPwozadcjOLr3O3GduxenFFSvYMLZ-v9zJkJfI6I2Ov4Dfw/viewform?usp=dialog]bug reports here[/url].

[h2]Changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Hold rotate buttons to do precise rotations
[*] Added descriptions to the items you pick up at the start
[*] You can sign completed pages
[/list]

[h2]Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed some box size issues on some objects when changing shape
[/list]

Thanks for joining the playtest of [b]ShantyTown[/b]!
-Erik
